title: SNAP federal income standards - FY 2026
facts: For SNAP fiscal year October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026, the federal gross monthly income standard for a 1-person household in the 48 contiguous states and D.C. is $1,696, and the net monthly income standard is $1,305.
For a 4-person household in the 48 contiguous states and D.C., the FY 2026 gross monthly standard is $3,483 and the net monthly standard is $2,680.

The standard gross-income test is generally 130% of the federal poverty level and the net-income test 100%, but categorical eligibility, household composition, age/disability rules and state options can change how tests apply.
Alaska and Hawaii use different federal standards.
